parsed_payload.reasoning: The braid arrangement x_i=x_j has chambers determined by the possible strict orderings of the five coordinates, so it has 5! = 120 chambers. Fix one chamber C, e.g. x_{\pi(1)}<...<x_{\pi(5)}. On C the sum s=x_1+...+x_5 is nonconstant: adding t(1,1,1,1,1) preserves all coordinate differences and changes s by 5t, so s takes every real value on C. Therefore the three added hyperplanes s=-1, s=0, s=1 all meet C, and as distinct parallel level sets they divide C into exactly 3+1=4 slabs. Since C is convex, each such slab is connected. No final region can cross one of the braid hyperplanes, because those hyperplanes are part of the arrangement, so each final region lies inside a single braid chamber. Thus each of the 120 braid chambers contributes exactly 4 regions. Total regions = 120*4 = 480. \boxed{480}
